title_ja: 当社の業務委託先におけるランサムウェア被害による情報漏えいのおそれについて
title_en: Regarding possible information leakage due to a ransomware attack at the company's outsourcing contractor
summary_en: On 11 July 2025, Daiichi Frontier Life Insurance announced that its contractor Shinchosha Co., Ltd. suffered a ransomware attack. Shinchosha handles in-person confirmation work for the insurer, such as locating customers with long-unclaimed benefits and confirming customers' intentions. Customer data that may have leaked includes policy number, name, date of birth, address, phone number, sex and sensitive information such as medical history. No leak or public release has been confirmed so far. Shinchosha is still working to establish the full extent of the damage with outside security experts.

title_ja: 当社の業務再委託先が使用するクラウドシステムにおける不正アクセス被害による情報漏えいについて
title_en: Information leak due to unauthorized access to a cloud system used by the company's business subcontractor
summary_en: Daiichi Frontier Life announced on 17 October 2025 that its annual customer survey response data leaked after unauthorized access to an input-support tool. The tool was used by Japan Aspect Core, a subcontractor of Nomura Research Institute, and was provided by Laurel Bank Machine. The leaked data was respondent IDs and free-text comments. Six respondents included names in their comments and will be contacted individually. The company found no sign of misuse. The tool is no longer in use, and no survey is currently running.

title_ja: 楽天銀行を通じたインターネット完結型の一時払個人年金保険 『プレミアカレンシー3楽天銀行エディション』の取扱いを開始
title_en: Start of handling of 'Premier Currency 3 Rakuten Bank Edition' (プレミアカレンシー3楽天銀行エディション), an internet-complete single-premium individual annuity through Rakuten Bank
summary_en: Daiichi Frontier Life and Rakuten Bank announced that from 15 June 2026 Rakuten Bank will sell "Premier Currency 3 Rakuten Bank Edition". It is a single-premium, currency-designated, interest-rate-variable individual annuity that the two companies developed jointly. Customers can complete the whole process online, from application to contract conclusion (service hours 7:00–25:00). The plan, currency and term can be chosen. The annuity fund amount is fixed in the designated currency at contract. Part of the cost savings from the online-only process is built into the product design.

title_en: Start of sales of 'Premier Receive 3' (プレミアレシーブ3), a fixed-term accumulation-fund-attached interest-rate-variable whole life insurance (26) (currency-designated type)
summary_en: Daiichi Frontier Life announced on 29 Oct 2026 that it will begin selling "Premier Receive 3" on 2 Nov 2026, rolling out gradually through financial-institution agencies. This is a single-premium whole life insurance with a variable accumulation rate and a designated currency (USD, AUD or JPY). Compared with Premier Receive 2, it adds a periodic-accumulation plan, where annual payments are left to accumulate and can be withdrawn at any time. It also adds a cap on periodic payments and longer rate-guarantee periods of 30 years for USD and JPY and 20 years for AUD.
